summary: Frontend regression after code-quality fixes (Blob URL print, stable React keys, catch logging). All targeted flows work: kasir POS receipt->print no JS errors, receipt-done closes dialog and empties cart; owner /dashboard renders charts (2 recharts SVGs); /laporan profit-loss renders (7 recharts SVGs); /riwayat detail dialog hist-print opens new tab without JS errors; admin & operator quick-login work; kasir login works. Print now opens a blob URL popup (blob:https://.../<uuid>) instead of document.write - verified no pageerrors nor console errors during/after clicks on receipt-print and hist-print.
critical_code_review_comments: printReceipt schedules URL.revokeObjectURL after 60s but if the parent tab navigates/closes earlier, the blob URL leaks - acceptable trade-off, low priority.
Popup blockers will silently fail (w==null returns early). Consider surfacing a toast so kasir knows to allow popups.
